extracted.intended_audience: Recipients of Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program (RWHAP) grants (Parts A–D), program administrators, and members of the public who may comment on the Information Collection Request (ICR).
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and notice for public comment on HRSA's proposed Information Collection Request to extend the Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program Allocations Report forms; includes reporting requirements, burden estimates, and instructions for submitting comments or requesting information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment submission requirements and deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments on this ICR should be received no later than February 17, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit your comments to paperwork@hrsa.gov or mail to the HRSA Information Collection Clearance Officer, Room 13N82, 5600 Fishers Lane, Rockville, Maryland 20857. When submitting comments or requesting information, please include the ICR title for reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requesting more information or draft instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: To request more information on the proposed project or to obtain a copy of the data collection plans and draft instruments, contact HRSA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email paperwork@hrsa.gov or call Samantha Miller, the HRSA Information Collection Clearance Officer, at (301) 443-3983. Include the ICR title when requesting information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to report Allocations and Expenditures Reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Recipients funded under RWHAP Parts A, B, C, and D are required to report financial data to HRSA at the beginning (Allocations Report) and at the end (Expenditures Report) of their grant budget period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This requirement applies to Parts A, B, C, and D recipients to allow HRSA to monitor and track use of grant funds for compliance with statutory, program and grants requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocations Reports data elements (what must be reported)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Allocations Reports request information recipients already collect, including the use of RWHAP grant funds for core medical and support services; and on various program components, such as administration, planning and evaluation, and clinical quality management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For RWHAP Parts A and B recipients funded under the Ending the HIV Epidemic (EHE) initiative, recipients are also required to report allocations of the grant budget period in the EHE Allocations and Expenditure Reports to track progress toward EHE goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of GCMS to avoid duplication and prepopulate data
rubrics_metrics.description: HRSA created an electronic grantee contract management system (GCMS) that includes data required for the Allocations Reports to avoid duplication and reduce recipient reporting burden.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recipients can access GCMS year‑round to upload or manually enter data on service provider contractors or subrecipients, services provided, and funding amounts. Data required for Allocations Reports are automatically prepopulated from GCMS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report forms proposed for extension
rubrics_metrics.description: HRSA proposes to extend the following report forms in their current status:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RWHAP Part A Allocations Report; RWHAP Part B Allocations Report; RWHAP Part B Supplemental Allocations Report; RWHAP Part C Allocations Report; RWHAP Part D Allocations Report; Ending the HIV Epidemic (EHE) Initiative Allocations Report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Need and proposed use of the information
rubrics_metrics.description: Accurate allocation records of recipients receiving RWHAP and EHE funding are necessary for HRSA to fulfill its monitoring and oversight responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HRSA will use the Allocation Reports to monitor and track the use of grant funds for compliance with statutory, program and grants requirements and to report progress toward program goals (including EHE).

rubrics_metrics.name: Likely respondents (who must respond)
rubrics_metrics.description: Likely Respondents: RWHAP Part A, Part B, Part C, and Part D recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Burden definition and explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden in this context means the time expended by persons to generate, maintain, retain, disclose, or provide the information requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes time to review instructions; develop, acquire, install, and use technology and systems for collecting, validating, verifying, processing and maintaining information; train personnel; search data sources; complete and review the collection of information; and to transmit or otherwise disclose the information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific topics HRSA requests comment on
rubrics_metrics.description: HRSA specifically requests comments on four topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: (1) the necessity and utility of the proposed information collection for the proper performance of the agency's functions; (2) the accuracy of the estimated burden; (3) ways to enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information to be collected; and (4) the use of automated collection techniques or other forms of information technology to minimize the information collection burden.
